source.method: Disassembly listings from ghidra-cli 12.1.4 and Capstone 5.0.7 were treated as leads. Every instruction sequence, table and string under staticChecks is confirmed against the pinned bytes by tools/verify_combat_result_element.py --exe, and the call, push and dword scans are recomputed from the image.

opcodes.countBound: none, one row is always staged (record count still holds the wire u16)
not bounded (record count still holds the wire u16)

stageRequest.trigger: control halfword nonzero for the header, row text ID nonzero for a row

classifier.rowSplit: type lane = effect id >> 24, middle lane = bits 12 to 23, low lane = bits 0 to 11, except type 0x0b keeps the low 24 bits as one value

headerPrecondition.rule: the container-selected element must cast to the character element type and lie closer than the radius

setterStore.value: low dword of the toward-zero truncated 64-bit integer

steps: skip the row when worldMasterTextId is zero
skip the row when the ordinal filter is on, a selector is set and the row ordinal differs
create a damage plate when the plate gate holds
call the message sound filter 0x005859f0 and skip the rest of the row when it returns false
run the special text ID switch
send the default log line unless text ID 0x75b4 took the special route
call the post routine 0x005785d0 with the row target and the record effect ID
set the selector to the row ordinal and clear the row text ID

specialTextIds.route: plate list at target element +0xe24 with the text parameter, then the default log
plate list at target element +0xe24 with parameter 0, no default log
when the target is the container-selected element, two named widgets are looked up and receive values built from the numeric value, then the default log
group list at target element +0xe4c with a flag and the numeric value, then the default log

soundTable.hitReturns: false unless the row target equals the actor returned by 0x004d7490

plates.digitOrder: least significant digit first into Number_5 through Number_1

implementNow: Drop a result without staging it when the element resolved from the sub-event source ID is in the rejecting state of the admission predicate (the client drops silently, so a drop counter is AUTHORED)

Stage one row for 0x0139 and the wire row count for 0x013A and 0x013B, with a caller-chosen cap of 10 and 18, and keep the wire count for 0x0139 and 0x013C records as the record count that the post size and row walk read, with a caller-chosen treatment of count against staged rows (AUTHORED)
Treat a row with text ID 0 as inert: no log line, no plate and no selector change
Route each drained record by class: copy it to the bucket ring, post scene command 3 for class 0 and 4 otherwise with 0x38 + 0x14 * rows bytes, and drop classes above 25
At drain time, for classes 6 to 10 inside the range gate, emit the header log line from the control halfword and clear the halfword
Skip the rest of a row when its text ID is in the 30-ID sound table of the message sound filter and its target is not the actor returned by 0x004D7490
Emit one log line per row as the 14-argument tuple, in row order, after the message sound filter of the sound effect page

Create one plate per row whose own effect ID is nonzero, with the kind in its bits 27 to 30, anchored on the source for kinds 7 to 10 and on the row target otherwise, showing the low five decimal digits of the numeric value in a ring of five slots per element
Take the plate gate as four host booleans: container override pointer set, configuration option (2, 5), global pointer set and global byte clear
Run the row pass only for classes 6 to 10 inside the range gate, because 0x0058CA80 runs 0x0058C220 for no other class
Pass the range gate only when the radius, read as an unsigned 32-bit integer and converted to a float, is strictly greater than the three-component distance (the unit stays CALIBRATION)
blocked: The publisher of event 0x59, so the frame on which rows run is an AUTHORED choice until a publisher is found
worldMaster text resolution for the logged message IDs
Per-kind plate visuals, animation durations and the layout of DamagePlateWidget.form
The display meaning of the +0xE24 plate list, the +0xE4C group list and the two named widgets
The initial value of the range radius at element +0xAA8 and any writer beyond its four setter call sites
The effect of the stage-time request 0x00578390 and of the post routine 0x005785D0 beyond their guards

boundaries: CALIBRATION: the frame on which row processing runs while event 0x59 has no identified publisher
CALIBRATION: the row cap for a wire count above the form capacity, which the client leaves unchecked
CALIBRATION: the unit of the range radius at element +0xAA8
UNPROVED: the display state values written for blocks past the last significant digit
INFERRED: the ring at element +0xA94 is never pushed because a Capstone displacement sweep of 0x00580000 to 0x005A0000 found no push site, so the drain call 0x0058A010 finds no entry

claims.claim: Before the range test the dispatcher exits for every opcode except 0x0004 while container byte +0x54B is nonzero or 0x00575740 on the object at container +0x510 returns true
The receive dispatcher sends every opcode from 0x012E to 0x013D to one shared lookup path
The lookup key is the sub-event header dword at +4 (the source actor ID), with 0x5FF8xxxx values remapped to 0x5FF80002 minus the low bit
A key with no registered element ends the packet and stages nothing
A found element receives the payload view through virtual slot 9, 0x0058CCA0
Slot 9 first calls 0x004D8830, which returns 0 only when element byte +0x92, pointer +0x80 and the readiness slot of that pointer are all nonzero
A zero result drops opcodes 0x0139 to 0x013C, and above 0x0134 only 0x0137, 0x0144, 0x0145, 0x0197 and 0x01A0 still pass
Opcodes 0x0139, 0x013A, 0x013B and 0x013C call the wrappers 0x0058C880, 0x0058C930, 0x0058C990 and 0x0058C7D0
Each wrapper classifies the effect ID with fallback 6, passes route flag 1 to its stager and queues the record at element +0xA80
The stagers read one row (0x0139), up to ten (0x013A), up to eighteen (0x013B) or none (0x013C)
Every staged record takes a serial from the shared counter at 0x01338D2C, skipping 0, and publishes it as bus command 0x39
The base stager copies the wire header fields to the record offsets of the field map
The row stagers copy target, numeric value, effect ID, text ID, text parameter and ordinal from the wire offsets of the row map
The ten-row and eighteen-row loops are bounded by the wire row count alone, and the single-row stager ignores it
A nonzero control halfword or row text ID makes the stager call 0x004D7470 and then 0x00578390
What 0x00578390 does after it skips effect IDs of type 0x10, type 0x14 and the ID 0x7C000062
The class comes from the effect ID type lane, four reserved types and a route-kind table
The table at 0x00FE32D8 has 34 valid rows of 12 bytes, and the classifier maps route kinds 8, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5
The element ring at +0xA80 stores private 0x1A0-byte copies at head plus count and grows through 0x00590070 when the new count would reach the capacity
Element slot 6 runs the drain once per call and the drain takes one record per pass
Classes 0 to 25 are copied to a bucket ring at +0x878 plus 0x14 times the class and larger classes are dropped
Class 0 posts bus command 3 and classes 1 to 25 post command 4, each with the record and 0x38 plus 0x14 times the row count bytes
Classes 3 to 11 then call 0x0058CA80, which runs the header for class 5 through 0x00585AF0 and for classes 6 to 10 through 0x0058C220, and does nothing for classes 3, 4 and 11
The header runs only when the container-selected element casts to a character element and lies closer than the radius at element +0xAA8

The range gate reads the radius dword at element +0xAA8 as an unsigned 32-bit value (0x00588E9D loads a signed integer and adds 2 to the 32nd power when the sign is set), and 0x005875A0 passes only when that radius is strictly greater than the three-component distance between the two elements
The radius setter 0x00585930 stores the low dword of the toward-zero truncated float as a 64-bit integer when its mode byte is 0, and stores 50 for five element kinds when the mode byte is 1
A nonzero control halfword is sent to the logger as a text ID with zero target, numeric value, effect ID and parameter, then cleared
The drain calls 0x0058CA80 with the arguments 1 and 0, which stops 0x0058C220 after the header line, so no row is processed at drain time
Rows are processed by element event 0x59, which finds the record by serial in its bucket ring and calls 0x0058CA80 with 0 and the record route flag, so the ordinal filter is on only for route flag 0
No code was found that publishes event 0x59, because the only command 0x44 publisher has no caller of its own
Event 0x59 searches only the bucket rings of classes 3 to 11 and 0x0058CA80 runs the row pass only for classes 6 to 10, so rows of every other class reach no row processing in the traced element code
Element event 0x64 stages a record through the same classifier and the single-row stager with route flag 0
The routine at 0x006AACE0 builds result views with numeric value 9999 and calls the wrappers 0x0058C880 and 0x0058C930 directly
Row processing runs the inert test, the ordinal filter, the plate, the sound filter, the special text ID switch, the default log, the post call and the selector update in that order
The sound filter 0x005859F0 compares the text ID with 30 u16 values at 0x01270BA4, which include 0x847F, 0x848E to 0x8495 and 0x8499 to 0x84A3 and exclude 0x75B1, 0x75B4, 0x846E and 0x8475

A table hit returns false unless the row target equals the actor ID returned by 0x004D7490, which skips the rest of the row (special routes, default log line, post call and selector update), while a miss or a matching target goes on to the 0x8475 and 0x846E sound tests and returns true
The default log call passes 14 arguments to 0x005759A0 in the listed order

Text IDs 0x75B1, 0x75B4, 0x847F, 0x848E to 0x8492, 0x8494, 0x8495 and 0x8499 to 0x84A3 take extra routes before or instead of the default log, and 0x8493 and 0x8496 to 0x8498 get the default line only
What the plate list at +0xE24 and the group list at +0xE4C display

A plate is created only when the container override pointer at +0x17838 is nonzero, configuration option (2, 5) is nonzero, the global pointer at 0x01356E10 is set and the global byte at 0x01356E14 is clear
Effect ID bits 27 to 30 give the kind, and kinds 7 to 10 anchor the plate on the record source and every other kind on the row target

The plate routine 0x00795630 reloads the row effect ID from record +0x40 plus 0x14 times the row at 0x007956D4 and, when it is 0, branches at 0x007956E5 to the epilogue 0x007967A2 before its inline kind decode at 0x007956ED and the layout jump table, so a row with effect ID 0 gets no plate and the row pass goes on to the sound filter
Each element keeps a ring of five plate slots, and a slot object is 0x48 bytes
The plate list initializer loads DamagePlateWidget.form, and a plate fills five digit blocks, an icon, an additional text and a damage type text
The numeric value is written least significant digit first into Number_5 through Number_1, so only the low five decimal digits show
A jump table with ten entries selects the plate layout by kind 1 to 10
The visual meaning of each kind, the animation duration and the widget layout
No staging or row-processing body reads a status-change field
No delay or timer constant is read between receive, drain and row processing
